character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist in every shot: dark indigo hair floating in soft waves, glowing aqua eyes, with a recognizable consistent face and adult body proportions. They are a deep-sea survey pilot exploring luminous trenches. Fixed costume: a streamlined navy pressure suit with turquoise illuminated seams and compact oxygen pack. Signature tool or keepsake: a wrist-mounted sonar compass with a glowing ring. Maintain the exact same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, proportions, costume silhouette, and signature object across the complete music video.
consistency_rules: One clearly defined protagonist leads this theme from beginning to end.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions in every scene.
Preserve the signature outfit, its color identity, and the defining tool or keepsake.
Do not redesign, replace, or multiply the lead character unless the lyrics explicitly require another person.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in subsea research stations, bioluminescent trenches, ancient underwater structures; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with abyssal blue, bioluminescent cyan, violet; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by wide establishing shot with layered depth, slow cinematic dolly-in with stable horizon, gentle lateral tracking shot revealing environmental detail; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
